propositions: AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE journal marker is emitted by autodeploy.sh but not published as a CloudWatch metric, making pressure-prune activity invisible without host journal access
During disk pressure incidents, operators cannot determine from CloudWatch alone whether the reclaim gate ran at all, requiring indirect inference from deploy_deferrals or direct host access

observability.sh must publish disk_pressure_prunes metric using the existing publish_autodeploy_marker_delta helper with record-anchored ERE pattern and offset file, matching the pattern of sibling autodeploy markers
The counter must seed to 0 on first run and track deltas on subsequent runs, not inherited journal totals
Diagnostic counter enables distinguishing gate-did-not-run from gate-ran-and-reclaimed-nothing in future incident investigations
